### 2026-10-18: original three-rung Jacobi witness passes; coherent source repair pushed

Source [`eae45684`](https://github.com/sunyaisblank/Sirius/commit/eae45684ee6f2d1b1baf9673a53ec9c349f936e1) shares pair, stencil-distance, geometry and RHS bodies with bounded loops, preserving the original evaluation order, precision policy, RK sums, records, assertions and refusal/commit behavior. Five new compiler targets passed; five canonical controls were explicitly reused with matching inputs. CUDA/Metal remain emission checks.

The **original** `KernelTrace.ActualTraceClipsJacobiAndRetainsInvalidSamplesAcrossRungs` completed FP32, compensated FP32 and positive FP64: one completed XML test, zero failures/errors/disabled/skips, `fp64_evidence` property name absent, and all nine ordered markers. Test XML time268.827s; owner268.994569284s under the original300s/4GiB/2GiB-reserve/default-cache/LVP0/JIT0 guards; peak sampled owner+target RSS1,966,104KiB. All1,550 before/after/current input rows and terminal ownership checks passed. This execution used the genuine f22 host plus the reviewed private modules. After adoption, the canonical backend host and all three generated/staged SPVs are **byte-identical to that tested tuple**, so the witness is reused without another runtime attempt. Execution paths/identities remain explicit.

The normal strict GCC14/C++26 Release build, original six targets and SourceGovernance passed on clean pushed `eae45684`; all4,917 frozen source/tool/configuration input rows remained exact. Canonical portable program text is identical except diagnostic `#line` filenames. Slang still emits conservative loop-carried initialization warnings; source/emitted reviews establish event0 writes before the corresponding uses, with the original three-rung runtime pass retained.

Raw source/compiler/runtime/profile data and independent audits are published in the [203-file evidence manifest](https://github.com/sunyaisblank/Sirius/blob/b86756348bc43f99eb6355e7524aa4a3b97656f0/attestations/scientific-core/f22dc025/trace-jacobi-shared-rhs-screen-runtime-profile/manifest.json). Existing build inputs were [checkpointed before overwrite](https://github.com/sunyaisblank/Sirius/blob/7a1d3bcefa1805ec85ca716c9cc9950f9d328e0a/attestations/scientific-core/f22dc025/source-build-input-checkpoint/manifest.json). Profiling observes LLVM machine-code/liveness/register-allocation work; unresolved stacks, observer accounting, late-only profiler locale pins and perf-injected diagnostic environment variables are explicitly disclosed. This is no comparative speedup or environment-identical performance claim.

[Current-source CI39082394780](https://github.com/sunyaisblank/Sirius/actions/runs/39082394780) is running the default three integration/build-only jobs. Native Radeon execution is next being prepared. **#53 remains open**: remaining P1–P6/E1–E4/full-science, retained latency and original cold-frame gate, full Mandatory, all eight external domains, exact-main/install/release and original July-image identity obligations remain outstanding. No unchanged cold-frame retry, guard increase, test weakening, early main merge or release promotion.

Earlier dated records follow unchanged.

Update 2026-10-17: the new private stencil/import-order offline screen completed all ten compiler cases; all five canonical controls were byte-equal and all six SPIR-V products validated. The original unchanged three-rung runtime remains **unaccepted**: it reached FP32 exercised, compensated-FP32 exercised and FP64 begin, then stopped at the 300-second guard (300.234975528 s; peak 2,917,884 KiB; child -15; no XML/final numerical verdict). Source/whole inputs stayed unchanged, cleanup succeeded, and actual LVP0/JIT0/default-cache ownership was bound. Markers alone are not numerical passes.

The combined 255-file source/product/runtime record is committed and pushed as `b7744af91a34eb9c4cae676b37e68363f79e477f`, tag `evidence/issue-53-stencil-screen-runtime-f22dc025`, under `attestations/scientific-core/f22dc025/trace-riemann-stencil-screen-and-private-runtime`. The candidate remains unapplied. No unchanged runtime retry or guard increase: remediation now shares duplicated segment geometry and RHS callsites while preserving the original evaluation work/order. The first geometry-sharing prototype has only offline FP32 validation/ABI evidence. Cold-frame, retained performance, full science/Mandatory, external domains and release acceptance remain open.

The independent audit checks 18,198 before/after input rows, 4,553 unique input identities and actual compiler PID/birth/exec/CWD source-open lineage. The root tracer is separately bound and outside Slang/controller RSS accounting; instrumented timings prove no performance benefit.

The replacement packet explicitly adds candidate-only private -I immediately before the original canonical -I. Actual same-birth source opens and ordinary emitted new-loop proof still gate candidate acceptance and later operations. Canonical source/build products remain f22dc025 and unchanged; neither private shader candidate has been adopted. Existing numerical, runtime, latency, cold-frame, eight-domain and release gates remain open.

### 2026-10-15 20:07 UTC: private Jacobi pair-loop screen preserved; original all-rung diagnostic still incomplete

Tracked source remains clean/pushed `f22dc025d112c2d967356dead6b6e9caf8b42d67`. The candidate trace shader is private and unapplied. The current Linux test host and the candidate modules have separately bound identities; this is **not canonical f22 shader qualification**.

The ten-operation compiler screen completed with all five controls byte-equal to their original canonical baselines. All six SPIR-V validation/disassembly operations completed, and independent ABI/CFG review retained seven bindings, the 272/480-byte continuation layouts and both ordered Jacobi-pair updates. Candidate SPIR-V files are 12.48%/12.47%/10.32% smaller (FP32/COMP/FP64). CUDA/Metal generated source is slightly larger and received no native compilation or execution. These are static facts, not a driver/JIT/RSS/performance or numerical benefit. The exact 213-file compiler bundle is published at [`d312cb97`](https://github.com/sunyaisblank/Sirius/blob/d312cb97f3be356f00aa15bc22ae6ea0abdd211e/attestations/scientific-core/f22dc025/trace-jacobi-pair-loop-compiler-screen/preservation.json).

The unchanged original `KernelTrace.ActualTraceClipsJacobiAndRetainsInvalidSamplesAcrossRungs` fixture then ran once using a genuine copy of the current Linux host and the three private candidate modules, actual LVP0 and the original default-cache/300s/4GiB aggregate-RSS/2GiB reserve guards. It **timed out**: owner wall 300.377911921s (last sampled elapsed 300.016530078s), child −15, 9,674 samples, peak 2,520,344 KiB, minimum available 12,827,736 KiB, no sampled RSS/reserve failure, no cleanup errors or remaining owned processes. All 1,645 before/after/current input identities matched; both saved controller/child births were freshly absent.

Exactly four progress lines were observed: FP32 begin/prepared/exercised, then COMP begin. COMP prepared/exercised and every FP64 marker were absent. **No completed XML, collector acceptance or all-rung numerical verdict exists.** Nonfatal expectations can precede an exercised marker, so these lines do not independently establish FP32 numerical PASS. The stop locates COMP's begin-to-prepared interval; it does not identify an allocating/JIT/dispatch call. No unchanged retry, larger guard or source adoption follows.

The 58-file negative-result bundle is independently audited and published at [`4a1883ed`](https://github.com/sunyaisblank/Sirius/blob/4a1883edc862b9cd4dcb342623d3a258b55c9d9c/attestations/scientific-core/f22dc025/trace-jacobi-pair-loop-private-runtime-timeout/preservation.json), including [the terminal audit](https://github.com/sunyaisblank/Sirius/blob/4a1883edc862b9cd4dcb342623d3a258b55c9d9c/attestations/scientific-core/f22dc025/trace-jacobi-pair-loop-private-runtime-timeout/files/out/trace-jacobi-pair-loop-runtime-pending/independent-completion-review.json). Its original broad all-regular-mappings prebound flag remains false: one writable shared Mesa default-cache index and eight runtime memfd allocation maps are separately disclosed; the other 52 saved immutable controller/child map rows match prelaunch inputs. The narrow classification preserves the original cache policy and makes no cache-cold, hit/miss, stable-cache-content or performance claim.

A distinct next **source-only** stencil-sharing candidate has passed independent source review: it retains original axis/distance order, positive-before-negative evaluations, coordinate/literal expressions, coefficient/store/division ordering and both precision stencils. No new candidate shader has been compiled or run yet. Its pending screen requires proof that Slang actually selected the two intended private sources and emitted the new bounded loop before any later operations; placement alone is insufficient. Canonical source/build products remain held unchanged. Original P2/all-science, native/full Mandatory, cold-frame/latency, physical image/memory, July identity, eight-domain and release obligations remain open.
